verdict.rationale: An in-dashboard AI assistant is a fair capability to expect from a backend platform's console, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only documents external-agent tooling: an MCP server, Skills files, Claude Code/Codex plugins, llms.txt and docs-as-markdown. Those let third-party agents work with Appwrite, which is an adjacent capability; nothing shows an assistant built into the Appwrite Console that writes queries, debugs errors or explains the backend.
